brief: Identify why a constant-return projection is a model rather than a guaranteed outcome.

title.pt-BR: Um modelo depende do que supõe

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "A projection depends on assumptions"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Una proyección depende de supuestos"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Um modelo depende do que supõe"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Identify why a constant-return projection is a model rather than a guaranteed outcome.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: Use modeled outcomes to explore possibilities without treating them as promises.
instruction.misconception: Reading a constant-return illustration as evidence that future returns, contributions and prices will follow that path.
instruction.numeracy_support: Every quantity and assumption needed to decide is visible in the current scenario. Examples explain the relationship before independent application.

evidence.reasoning: A projection answers what happens if assumptions hold. Changed returns, deposits, fees or prices can change the outcome.
The curve follows an input assumption, not evidence of future performance.
Excluded costs must be included before interpreting a net result.
A forecast must change when its funding assumptions change.
Historical results do not prove the same sequence will recur.
Alternative assumptions expose sensitivity without predicting the actual future.
A precise printed number can still depend on uncertain assumptions.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Retrieve this competence in the declared later course reviews and through the existing shared review system.

en-US.line: Use modeled outcomes to explore possibilities without treating them as promises.

es-MX.line: Usa resultados modelados para explorar posibilidades sin tratarlos como promesas.

pt-BR.line: Use um modelo para ver o que pode ocorrer, sem tomar isso como promessa.

en-US.line: A projection answers what happens if assumptions hold. Changed returns, deposits, fees or prices can change the outcome.

es-MX.line: Una proyección muestra qué ocurre si se cumplen supuestos. Cambiar rendimientos, depósitos, cargos o precios puede cambiar el resultado.

pt-BR.line: Um modelo mostra o que ocorre se tudo seguir seu plano. Ganhos, aportes, custos ou preços podem mudar.

options.label: A promise of actual yearly returns

help: Separate a chosen rate from an observed or guaranteed result.

options.label: O que ocorre com essa regra
Prova de que não há perdas

en-US.prompt: Can it describe the actual net result?
en-US.scene: A projection excludes fees; the actual arrangement charges fees.
help: Identify which actual costs are missing from the model.

feedback.met: Excluded costs must be included before interpreting a net result.
feedback.not_yet: Identify which actual costs are missing from the model.

feedback.met: Incluye costos omitidos antes de interpretar un resultado neto.
feedback.not_yet: Identifica costos reales que faltan en el modelo.

pt-BR.scene: Uma projeção exclui tarifas; o acordo real cobra tarifas.

options.label: Sim, uma curva suave inclui tudo

feedback.met: Some custos que faltam antes de ver quanto sobra.
feedback.not_yet: Veja quais custos reais não estão no modelo.

en-US.prompt: What should change in the projection?

help: Model actual planned inputs rather than wishful ones.

feedback.met: A forecast must change when its funding assumptions change.
feedback.not_yet: Model actual planned inputs rather than wishful ones.

es-MX.scene: El pronóstico suponía depósitos mensuales; dejaron de hacerse.
